name: Domino Euchre
description: Domino Euchre is a trump trick-taking domino game inspired by card euchre, using a double-six set and contract-style play.

overview.description: Domino Euchre is a trump trick-taking domino game inspired by card euchre, using a double-six set and contract-style play.

history.origins: Domino Euchre developed as a tile adaptation of euchre-style trick taking, preserving trump and contract ideas in domino form.
timeline: Late 19th to early 20th century: domino trick variants gained popularity in social clubs.
Modern era: rules consolidated in hobby rule collections and online references.
history.cultural: Played in dealer's-choice circles that mix card and tile trick games.
history.evolution: Card-rank ordering was replaced by domino suit and pip hierarchy while keeping trump resolution.

setup.dealing: All tiles are shuffled face-down and dealt evenly; bidding determines trump and contract.

rules.objective: Win enough tricks to make contract and outscore opponents.
rules.gameplay: After dealing, players bid for the right to name trump. Trick play follows suit where possible, with trump tiles outranking non-trump tiles. Partnerships score based on contract success and tricks captured.
keyRules: Players must follow suit when they can.
Highest legal tile in led suit or trump wins the trick.

strategy.basic: Preserve high trump tiles for key tricks.
strategy.intermediate: Bid conservatively when your partner's likely support is uncertain.
strategy.advanced: Track void suits and force opponents into weak trump exchanges.
tips: Lead strong suit chains early to test opponent voids.
Coordinate contract pressure with partner-safe leads.

variations.emptyOverridesReason: Short game only changes target score; no engine overrides documented in sources.

scoring.description: Partnerships score for making contract and trick totals.

synthesis.shortDescription: A partnership trick-taking domino game with euchre-style bidding and trump.
